2608.28179.title: Conformal Risk-Averse Decision Making with Optimized Certainty Equivalent Risk Control
2608.28179.paper_summary: We study risk-averse decision making, in which an agent selects actions while being uncertain about the true system state. The risk is measured via optimized certainty equivalent (OCE) metrics, which generalize popular criteria such as mean-variance risk and conditional value-at-risk (CVaR). We characterize the optimal policy under known distributions, and show that it reduces to a prediction set-based solution for the CVaR. This provides an operational interpretation of conformal prediction-type prediction sets. For unknown distributions, we develop a data-driven calibration strategy, based on a synthetic model for the likelihood and held-out calibration data, yielding high-probability control of the OCE risk. The approach is evaluated on two wireless beamforming settings.
2608.28179.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究風險厭惡的決策制定，其中一個代理在對真實系統狀態感到不確定的情況下選擇行動。風險是通過優化的確定性等價 (OCE) 指標來衡量的，這些指標概括了流行的標準，如均值-方差風險和條件風險價值 (CVaR)。我們在已知分佈下描述最佳政策，並顯示它簡化為基於預測集的 CVaR 解決方案。這為符合預測類型的預測集提供了操作性解釋。對於未知分佈，我們基於合成模型和保留的校準數據開發了一種數據驅動的校準策略，從而實現對 OCE 風險的高概率控制。該方法在兩個無線波束成形設置中進行了評估。
2608.28179.author: Amirmohammad Farzaneh et.al.
